items.headline: Revolut completes fundraising at $115 billion valuation

fact.value: Revolut completed its fundraising process, establishing a $115 billion valuation

items.headline: Italian regulator fines Revolut €11.5m over misleading trading ads

fact.value: Italian competition watchdog fined Revolut about €11.5 million; Revolut disputes it and plans to appeal

red_flags.flag: Co-founder Vlad Yatsenko to step down as CTO, effective 1 July 2026

fact.value: Co-founder Vlad Yatsenko steps down as CTO effective 1 July 2026; moves to non-executive board role
fact.note: Announcement date not confirmed in source

red_flags.flag: Italian regulator fined €11.5m over misleading ads, Apr 2026

fact.value: Italian competition watchdog fined about €11.5 million over misleading 0% commission trading ads

red_flags.flag: Lithuania fined €3.5m over money laundering monitoring, Apr 2025

fact.value: Bank of Lithuania fined Revolut €3.5 million over money laundering control shortcomings
fact.note: Revolut said no confirmed money laundering instances were identified

highlights: Completed fundraise set a $115 billion valuation, announced 4 November 2026, led by Glade Brook Capital, Coatue and Durable Capital
